description: This file contains macro guards and function declarations related to the MDIO (Management Data Input/Output) interface for the RT2880 chipset in RALINK-based devices. It provides function prototypes for link adjustment, reading and writing MDIO registers, and initializing ports.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts the MDIO link status for a given private network device structure and port.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_read
methods.description: Reads a value from a specified MDIO register for a particular PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_mdio_write
methods.description: Writes a value to a specified MDIO register for a particular PHY address and register.

methods.name: rt2880_port_init
methods.description: Initializes a network port based on device tree node information.
